_website: TASK 6. THE HOMEPAGE'S WebSite node, carrying the SearchAction for Google's sitelinks searchbox. Only `name` is stored here — `url` and the SearchAction's urlTemplate are built by scripts/build-hero.mjs through S.abs() at build time, never pasted as a literal, because a literal origin has corrupted this site's own sitemap and robots.txt before (lib/org.ts:22-47). It is a sibling of `jsonld`, not a property inside it, because WebSite and NGO are two different schema.org things that both happen to be named Swechha, the same way a real newspaper's masthead and its publisher share a name without being the same entity.
